body:
The source candidate now automatically retains the supported native reward-disagreement failure without per-task log hash inputs. The real archived #47 failure passed source/task/agent/worker checks, anonymous HF readback and verification of the already completed original cleanup. Scientific acceptance stays false; original logs, rewards, held journal and cumulative budget are unchanged. [Results and exact receipts](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6bff8b47/experiments/51-held-retention/results.md).

**Validation:** 35 offline tests cover interruption/replay, altered inputs, unsafe logs, both controls, foreign workers/resources, protected public base and unchanged admission limits. The separate actual proof used the installed #50 wheel with the original plan/backend/publication policy. No new native job, cleanup, model call or capacity was needed. HF copies contain reviewed existing public bytes plus own provenance metadata; original source terms remain.

**Remaining:** extract the actor into a supported installed interface and integrate the serial generation loop. Support currently covers only pinned `Native reward disagreement`; other holds remain explicit. This is archived failure/cleanup evidence, not fresh native execution or task acceptance. Keep #51/#33 open for review, with detailed logs in comments.

Existing epic limits remain 32 CPUh/$90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra. Actual 9.596001 CPUh, 11 original calls/$0.287646, zero CPU reservations and the same $10 archival reservation unreconciled. No additional model/solver repair, regeneration, new capacity, automatic merge or dataset release.
